# mermaid

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Mermaid as a code preview: a mermaid fence (in markdown, or a page code block set to mermaid) drawn as its diagram — lazy-loaded, themed from the surrounding theme tokens, with the parse error shown in place of (or under the last good) diagram.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `CodePreview.Renderer` "mermaid"
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/css/center.Center`
    - `primitives/css/scroll.Scroll`
    - `primitives/lazy-component.lazyComponent`
    - `primitives/loading.Loading`
    - `primitives/syntax-highlight.useDarkMode`
    - `primitives/syntax-highlight/code-preview.CodePreview`
    - `primitives/syntax-highlight/code-preview.CodePreviewError`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-md`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-sm`
